workload.description: Seeded mixed recall workload against Automaton ensureMouth + StaffStore + queryFirst. Several hundred turns: paraphrases of stored findings, follow-ups, changed requirements, evolved repositories, stale findings, conflicting claims, and unrelated questions. Measures current gates (RECALL_REQUEST, uniqueSpeakable, skip stale, taskKey, owner) without retuning queryFirst. Temp sqlite only; never ~/.automaton/staff.sqlite. This is not the 19/20 repeated-work replay and does not validate 95%.
